title: Oasis Water-Drawing and Shaded Rest Corner
description: One fixed oasis water-drawing and rest scene using four complete unchanged original models: a fan palm behind an offset stone well and a separate four-post sloping canopy over a slatted bench. Original hollow well, recessed opaque water, bucket, crank, entire palm crown, full canopy and all bench geometry/PBR remain at unit scale. Three closed scene-only sandy support meshes provide the base, low well-stone plinth and exact bedding under every complete tilted bench-foot patch. Four bounded static clear volumes distinguish the front cross-passage, well approach, canopy entrance and bench-front space. One scene, zero new independent models; no prior scene is imported. The .15m scene edge needs external placement. Static appearance only: no potable-water, water supply or circulation, pumping, fluid simulation, biological, ecological, climate, heat-comfort, ultraviolet, navigation, controller, ergonomics, accessibility, load, stability, manufacture or safety certification.
